nodes.label: Nindova contributor guidance
nodes.description: Repository-level product invariants and working rules for behavior-preserving implementation and verification.

nodes.label: Two-Loop Law
nodes.description: Satisfaction may exist inside one bounded Session, while pull may exist only between Sessions.

nodes.label: Hybrid Procedural Illustration
nodes.rationale: Retain responsive, asset-light procedural atmosphere while giving emotionally important focal objects and characters an authored illustrated finish.

nodes.label: Hybrid Procedural and Composed Audio
nodes.rationale: Keep continuous ambience adaptive and lightweight while composed closure accents carry the product's sonic identity.

nodes.label: User-Chosen Unguilted Wall
nodes.rationale: Preserve meaningful precommitment without preselection, repeated nagging, punitive blocking, or delegated scheduling.

nodes.label: Asymmetric Vista Memory
nodes.rationale: Use bounded, non-numeric continuity without creating a countable collection, skipped-night loss, or attendance pressure.

nodes.label: Fifteen-Minute Session Cap
nodes.rationale: At the cap, one final response hands control to autonomous return so responsiveness cannot weaken the promise that the Session ends itself.

nodes.label: Portrait-First Session
nodes.rationale: Act-specific portrait composition and semantic equivalents must precede interaction polish because uniform landscape shrinking conflicts with phone-in-bed use.

nodes.label: Browser and PWA Before iOS Wall
nodes.rationale: Family Controls entitlement and Gate-routing uncertainty must not delay or weaken a complete browser-first experience.
nodes.norm_label: browser and pwa before ios wall

nodes.label: Public Site and Session Separation
nodes.rationale: Keep documentation searchable and marketing calm without making the nightly Session depend on the public-site framework.

nodes.label: Punjabi and Indian Material World
nodes.rationale: Ground the room and Vistas in specific everyday Punjabi and Indian materials, landscapes, geometry, and familiar objects.

nodes.label: Cultural Visual Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Avoid religious, nationalistic, exotic, festival, flag, sacred-symbol, and unrelated-collage treatments.

nodes.label: Theme and Behavior Independence
nodes.rationale: English UI and cultural styling must not alter the fixed path, accessibility equivalents, decay, closure, or behavioral claims.

nodes.label: Observational Test Limitation
nodes.rationale: The supplied test is retained only as observational evidence because it suppresses its end-card timeout and logs instead of asserting.

nodes.label: Decay-Driven Assistance
nodes.rationale: Time and completion progress increase snap and auto-fit help while light, labels, patience, and required effort decay toward autonomous closure.

nodes.label: Two-Loop Law
nodes.author: Claude
nodes.rationale: Keep satisfaction and closure inside one Session while placing curiosity and ritual only between Sessions; anything that makes tonight harder to leave is a bug.

nodes.label: Bounded Self-Ending Session
nodes.author: Claude
nodes.rationale: The fixed nightly arc becomes easier, darker, and less demanding until it closes itself without scores, failure, or sleep-performance framing.

nodes.label: Morning Dawn Reward
nodes.author: Claude
nodes.rationale: Put delight, sharing, and reward energy in the morning so it cannot extend the nighttime Session.

nodes.label: Behavioral Anti-Metrics
nodes.author: Claude
nodes.rationale: Watch session length, sessions per night, and late-night reopens downward, and never claim clinical sleep outcomes.

nodes.label: Evidence-Led Build Protocol
nodes.author: Claude
nodes.rationale: Interview before coding, plan Must/Should/Could, preserve the seed and debug contract, build in slices, and test each change against satisfaction versus added pull.

nodes.label: Bourke et al. 2026 JAMA Pediatrics Study
nodes.author: Claude
nodes.norm_label: bourke et al. 2026 jama pediatrics study

nodes.label: Deterministic Solvable Closure
nodes.rationale: A fixed exhaustively verified board provides legible pair removal without dead states, performance scoring, reshuffling, or an unbounded ending.

nodes.label: Punjabi-Inspired Indian Kitchen Direction
nodes.rationale: Everyday Indian kitchen forms and restrained Punjabi-inspired materials provide cultural specificity while avoiding religious, nationalistic, festival-collage, and generic exotic styling.

nodes.label: Local-Only Privacy Boundary
nodes.rationale: Only bounded Dawn and return-intention facts persist long term; interaction timing remains same-tab and no runtime data leaves the device.

nodes.label: Product and Evidence Boundary
nodes.rationale: Nindova is a behavioral hypothesis rather than a sleep treatment, and browser automation cannot substitute for unperformed device, assistive-technology, cultural, or native-Wall proof.

nodes.label: Legacy Vista Dawn Composition
nodes.rationale: Migrated v1 and v2 completions remain honestly viewable in their original window without pretending that a Vista completion was a Rasoi board.

nodes.label: Frozen Wall Agency Contract
nodes.rationale: Native Screen Time behavior depends on entitlements and OS behavior that a web implementation cannot prove, while the future Gate must preserve user choice and unguilted dismissal.

nodes.label: Ephemeral Same-Tab Resume
nodes.rationale: Session storage may retain an unfinished board and absolute boundaries across same-tab reload while tab closure abandons the Session without creating Dawn completion history.

nodes.label: Two-Loop Law
nodes.rationale: Satisfaction may exist inside a Session but must never make tonight harder to leave.

nodes.label: No Performance or Escalation Layer
nodes.rationale: A single deterministic rule, universal solvability, optional help, identical replay, and absent scores, timers, collections, grades, and randomized rewards prevent an escalating performance loop.

nodes.label: Punjabi-Inspired Cultural Direction
nodes.rationale: Everyday kitchen forms and restrained material cues ground the product while explicitly excluding sacred symbols, flags, festival collage, exotic styling, and unsupported authenticity claims.
